comment: WORLDMAP.md item 10, the first site on the 120x120 to get a room behind its door. Walked the whole way rather than started by hand: onto the door cell on the world map, through the town's gate, past the Sighting Bell, in at Ye Final Shoppe's door, and round Gideon's shop. The point of walking it is that a site door is a *placeholder replaced* - journey.world_map drops the two inert events worldmap.json ships for Penultima and builds real ones on the same cells - and nothing but arriving proves the swap landed on the right squares.

steps.label: Penultima has two door events, one per cell of its Town B stamp
and neither of them is a placeholder any more - they carry no site note, because they are this game's events now and not the world map's

steps.comment: Onto the western door cell. Player-touch, below characters, which is the world map's idiom for a place you walk into.

steps.label: standing on Penultima's door, on the tower road
THE POINT: this door does something now
inside Penultima
just inside the gate, on the street

steps.comment: The town sign, which is the cliche the whole place is made of.

steps.label: under the sign, facing it - a SIGNPOST tile blocks its own cell and is read from beside it
The Last Town Before The End is a trope

steps.comment: The Sighting Bell, two squares along, which is why the prices are what they are.

steps.label: on the bell's square
walking in rings it - a Chosen One has been sighted on the road
and the shop that doubles its prices for a hero is the second one
the bell does not ring twice for the same customer

steps.comment: Along the street and in at Ye Final Shoppe. Its door is player-touch at 'same as characters', so it is triggered by walking into it from the square below.

steps.label: below the shop door
inside Ye Final Shoppe
on the mat

steps.comment: The window. The Sword of Ultimate Ending is a prop with a price card and is deliberately not stock - Game_Party.maxGold is 99,999,999, so a sword priced at 9,999,999 that a shop list could sell is a sword somebody eventually buys.

steps.label: under the window, facing it
the unaffordable ultimate weapon in the first window is the third
and nothing was gained: it is scenery, not an item

steps.comment: Dorothy, at the counter. Register A, by the innocent superlative - NORTH.md 1.3 item 1.

steps.label: she blocks her own square, so walking into her turns you to face her
talking to Dorothy
one thing nobody quite said, and the game never lets on
and her second page, the eleven coppers, does not bump it again

steps.comment: Gideon. His self switch is set first so that he gives the short version: advance is wrong for a page that ends in Shop Processing, because the interpreter stays running for as long as the shop is up and every confirm press goes into Scene_Shop.

steps.label: in front of Gideon, who is in the window, as ever
Welcome! What are you buying?
eight lines of stock, all of it potions - Last Chance For Potions
every one at a custom price, so doubling them here changes nothing anywhere else in the game
a Potion is sixty, and Penultima is charging a hundred and twenty, which he calls seasonal

steps.comment: One Escape, not two: a second lands on the map and opens the menu.

steps.label: back out of the counter

steps.comment: And out again, the way the party came in. The shop's exit tile is below characters, and so is the town's gate - and it is at the foot of the doorway notch, two rows below the last floor row, not on it.

steps.label: back in line with the door
out onto the street

steps.comment: Back along the UPPER row of the street. The Sighting Bell stands on the lower one at (5,11), and its second page is still a player-touch message - walking home over it stops the party dead and every arrow press after that goes into a message window instead of the walk, which reads as a dropped press and is not one.

steps.label: beside the gate, on the upper row of the road

steps.comment: The gate is the edge column, both rows of the road (October 2026), so one more press west is out.

steps.label: and back out onto the tower road
on the road itself, one west of the door - the square places.PENULTIMA_STEP names, checked standable against the finished map
in the northern half of the world, where the goblins are
